name: AbnormaLife_Toshoshitsu to Ore to Labrador Retriever
original_name: AbnormaLife_図書室と俺とラブラドールレトリバー
source:
Manabu Hirose, was a genius. 

His life stained by loss and separation, Manabu was far from home and distant from people, emotionally. He genius was an undiscovered secret, as he lived the life of a normal student. 

That day, in the rain, he got to know classmate Hikari Hyuga. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE160586.html]DLsite English[/url]]
